quantra_Period.description:
Canonical period type used across APIs. Both fields are presence-required:
a bare `n` would silently default to 0 and an omitted `unit` would silently
mean Months, so a forgotten value is a 400 naming the field rather than a
silent (0 Months) tenor.

quantra_FlowInterest.description: Interest cash flow with fixing and accrual metadata.

quantra_FlowsWrapper.description: Wrapper for a single flow in a collection.

quantra_Schedule.description: Date schedule definition for payment and accrual dates.

end_of_month.description:
Presence-required: absent-vs-false silently changes schedule dates for
month-end-anchored (money-market) schedules.

first_date.description:
Optional. ISO-8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). When present, passed as QuantLib's
firstDate, which controls the FIRST stub coupon: with Backward date
generation a first_date after effective_date creates a short/long first
period; with Forward generation it anchors the regular periods. Must lie
strictly between effective_date and termination_date. Omit for no first
stub (bit-identical to prior behaviour).

next_to_last_date.description:
Optional. ISO-8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). When present, passed as QuantLib's
nextToLastDate, controlling the LAST stub coupon symmetrically to
first_date. Must lie strictly between effective_date and
termination_date (and, when first_date is also present, on or after it).
Omit for no last stub (bit-identical to prior behaviour).

quantra_Fixing.description: Historical index fixing for seasoned instruments.

quantra_IndexDef.description: Complete index definition. Registered once per request, referenced by id.

index_type.description:
IBOR or Overnight. Determines QuantLib class used. Presence-required: an
omitted value is a 400, never the silent Ibor default.

tenor.description: Tenor period (e.g., 6 Months for Euribor 6M, 0 Days for overnight).

fixing_days.description: Fixing days (e.g., 2 for Euribor, 0 for SOFR/ESTR). Presence-required.

end_of_month.description:
End of month rule (IBOR only, ignored for overnight). Presence-required:
absent-vs-false silently changes money-market schedule dates.

fixings.description: Past fixings needed for seasoned instruments.

quantra_IndexRef.description: Reference to an IndexDef by its id.

quantra_CurveRef.description: Exogenous curve reference for multi-curve bootstrapping.

quantra_HelperDependencies.description: Exogenous curve dependencies for dual-curve bootstrapping.

discount_curve.description: Exogenous discount curve for dual-curve bootstrapping.

projection_curve.description:
Exogenous projection/forwarding curve. Reserved for
TenorBasisSwapHelper (not implemented yet); rejected on SwapHelper,
OISHelper and DatedOISHelper, whose projection curve is always the
curve being bootstrapped. The FX helpers carry their own explicit
curve references instead.

rate.description: Deposit rate. One of rate or quote_id must be provided.

quote_id.description: Optional: reference a shared quote by id instead of inline rate.

rate.description: FRA rate. One of rate or quote_id must be provided.

Implied rate. Used when futures_price is absent. One of rate,
futures_price or quote_id must be provided.

futures_price.description: Futures price (e.g., 95.25); when present, rate is ignored.

convexity_adjustment.description: Convexity adjustment added to implied rate.

quantra_SwapHelper.description: Vanilla IBOR swap helper. Uses IndexRef to reference an IndexDef.

rate.description: Swap rate. One of rate or quote_id must be provided.

float_index.description: Reference to an IndexDef by id (e.g., "EUR_6M").

deps.description: Exogenous discount curve for multi-curve bootstrapping.

rate.description:
Bond quote as a rate-style value. Used when price is absent. One of
rate, price or quote_id must be provided.

face_amount.description:
Bond face amount. Presence-required and must be > 0 (a bare double would
default to a silent zero face).

coupon_rate.description:
Coupon rate. Presence-required (a bare double would default to a silent
zero coupon); may be negative, only a missing or non-finite value is rejected.

redemption.description:
Redemption as a percentage of face. Presence-required and must be > 0
(a bare double would default to a silent zero redemption that destroys
the helper).

price.description: Bond (clean) price; when present, rate is ignored.

quantra_OISHelper.description: OIS helper. Uses IndexRef to reference an overnight IndexDef.

rate.description: OIS rate. One of rate or quote_id must be provided.

overnight_index.description: Reference to an overnight IndexDef by id (e.g., "USD_SOFR").

calendar.description:
Required. Feeds QuantLib's PAYMENT calendar slot on the bootstrapped
OIS (payment-date adjustment on both legs).

fixed_leg_frequency.description:
Required. Feeds QuantLib's PAYMENT frequency slot on the bootstrapped
OIS (the coupon frequency of both legs unless overridden by QuantLib's
fixed-frequency override, which is not exposed here).

fixed_leg_convention.description:
Required. Feeds QuantLib's PAYMENT business-day convention slot on the
bootstrapped OIS.

fixed_leg_day_counter.description:
DEPRECATED / accepted-but-unused. No QuantLib OISRateHelper overload
accepts a fixed-leg or payment day counter (the day counts come from the
overnight index and QuantLib's internal fixed-leg default), so this field
is ignored if present and may be omitted. Kept optional for backward
compatibility.

payment_lag.description:
Payment lag in business days between accrual end and payment. Required;
must be >= 0. Name mirrors OvernightCoupons.payment_lag.

averaging_method.description:
Compound or Simple averaging of the overnight fixings. Required.
Name mirrors OvernightCoupons.averaging_method.

lookback_days.description:
Fixing lookback in business days. Required; must be >= 0; 0 = no
lookback (the index's own fixing delay applies — QuantLib encodes this
as Null, not as a zero-day lookback). Name mirrors
OvernightCoupons.lookback_days.

lockout_days.description:
Lockout (rate-cutoff) days at period end. Required; must be >= 0;
0 = no lockout. Name mirrors OvernightCoupons.lockout_days.

apply_observation_shift.description:
Whether the observation-shift convention applies to the lookback.
Required. Name mirrors OvernightCoupons.apply_observation_shift.

deps.description: Exogenous discount curve for dual-curve OIS bootstrapping.

quantra_DatedOISHelper.description: Dated OIS helper with explicit start/end dates.

rate.description: OIS rate. One of rate or quote_id must be provided.

overnight_index.description: Reference to an overnight IndexDef by id.

calendar.description:
Required. Despite the generic name, this feeds QuantLib's PAYMENT
calendar slot on the bootstrapped OIS (kept under its historical name
for wire compatibility).

fixed_leg_frequency.description:
Required. Feeds QuantLib's PAYMENT frequency slot on the bootstrapped
OIS (the coupon frequency of both legs unless overridden by QuantLib's
fixed-frequency override, which is not exposed here). Name mirrors
OISHelper.fixed_leg_frequency.

fixed_leg_convention.description:
Required. Despite the fixed-leg name, this feeds QuantLib's PAYMENT
business-day convention slot on the bootstrapped OIS (kept under its
historical name for wire compatibility).

fixed_leg_day_counter.description:
DEPRECATED / accepted-but-unused. No QuantLib OISRateHelper overload
accepts a fixed-leg or payment day counter, so this field is ignored if
present and may be omitted. Kept optional for backward compatibility.

payment_lag.description:
Payment lag in business days between accrual end and payment. Required;
must be >= 0. Name mirrors OvernightCoupons.payment_lag.

averaging_method.description:
Compound or Simple averaging of the overnight fixings. Required.
Name mirrors OvernightCoupons.averaging_method.

lookback_days.description:
Fixing lookback in business days. Required; must be >= 0; 0 = no
lookback (the index's own fixing delay applies — QuantLib encodes this
as Null, not as a zero-day lookback). Name mirrors
OvernightCoupons.lookback_days.

lockout_days.description:
Lockout (rate-cutoff) days at period end. Required; must be >= 0;
0 = no lockout. Name mirrors OvernightCoupons.lockout_days.

apply_observation_shift.description:
Whether the observation-shift convention applies to the lookback.
Required. Name mirrors OvernightCoupons.apply_observation_shift.

deps.description: Exogenous discount curve for dual-curve OIS bootstrapping.

quantra_ZeroRatePoint.description: Zero rate point for direct curve construction (no bootstrapping).

date.description: Maturity date for the zero rate (YYYY-MM-DD).

zero_rate.description: Zero rate for this maturity. Required.

compounding.description: Compounding convention for the zero rate.

quantra_DiscountFactorPoint.description:
Discount-factor point for direct curve construction (no bootstrapping).
Feeds a QuantLib InterpolatedDiscountCurve: the discount factors are
interpolated directly, which differs from interpolating zero rates.

date.description: Maturity date for the discount factor (YYYY-MM-DD).

discount_factor.description:
Discount factor to this maturity. Required; must be in (0, 1]. The first
point (reference date) must carry a discount factor of exactly 1.0.

quantra_ForwardRatePoint.description:
Forward-rate point for direct curve construction (no bootstrapping).
Feeds a QuantLib InterpolatedForwardCurve: the INSTANTANEOUS,
continuously-compounded forward rate f(t) is interpolated directly (this is
the quantity InterpolatedForwardCurve integrates to obtain zero rates and
discount factors — NOT a simple/discrete forward over a period). This
interpolates a DIFFERENT quantity than InterpolatedZero or
InterpolatedDiscount, so off-node values differ for the same market data.

date.description: Node date for the forward rate (YYYY-MM-DD).

forward_rate.description:
Instantaneous, continuously-compounded forward rate at this node.
Required. May be negative in some markets; only non-finite is rejected.

spread.description: Basis spread. One of spread or quote_id must be provided.

quantra_FxSwapHelper.description:
FX swap helper (QuantLib FxSwapRateHelper). Bootstraps the discount curve
of the NON-collateral currency of the pair from FX swap points, given the
spot and the discount curve of the collateral currency: the implied
forward S + points must reprice to S * DF_collateral(T) / DF_other(T) from
the spot date. The curve being bootstrapped is always the other
currency's discount curve; the collateral curve is an exogenous curve the
bootstrapper builds first (dependency ordering), so the two may never be
the same curve.

quote_id.description:
Reference to a shared quote in pricing.quotes (quote_type = Curve: the
points move with rates, so they take part in the curve bump) instead of
an inline fx_points value.

tenor.description: Forward tenor from the spot date (1W, 1M, 3M, ...). Required.

fx_spot.description:
Id of the FxSpotSpec in pricing.fx.spots. Required. The spot supplies
the pair, the spot rate, the spot lag (QuantLib fixingDays), the joint
settlement calendar and the business-day convention of the helper.

end_of_month.description: End-of-month rule for the forward date. Required.

collateral_currency.description:
ISO code of the collateral currency: the currency whose discount curve
is given (collateral_curve). Required; must equal the spot's
base_currency or quote_currency. The curve being bootstrapped is then
the discount curve of the other currency of the pair.

collateral_curve.description:
Discount curve of the collateral currency, by id. Required; must name
another curve of pricing.rates.curves, which is bootstrapped first.

quantra_CrossCcyBasisHelper.description:
Cross-currency basis swap helper (QuantLib
ConstNotionalCrossCurrencyBasisSwapRateHelper). Bootstraps the discount
curve of ONE currency of the pair from a constant-notional cross-currency
basis swap: a base-currency floating leg against a quote-currency floating
leg, notional 1 in each currency exchanged at the start and at the end of
the swap, the basis spread added to one of the two legs. The other
currency's discount curve, both legs' forwarding curves and the two indices
are given; the curve being bootstrapped is the discount curve of the leg
whose *_discount_curve reference is absent (the classic use: a EUR curve
for USD-collateralised trades, quote_discount_curve = the USD OIS curve,
base_discount_curve absent).

Constant notional: both notionals stay fixed for the life of the swap, so
the FX spot rate cancels from the par condition and never enters the
bootstrap. The spot is still referenced (fx_spot) because it names the
pair: the two indices must be in its base and quote currencies, and its
spot lag is the swap's settlement lag.

Legs: an IBOR index pays at its own tenor (one fixing per period); an
overnight index pays a compounded coupon every payment_frequency. The
spread_on_base_leg flag, the collateral side and the basis sign follow
QuantLib's convention for the pair (EUR/USD: collateral in USD, basis on
the EUR leg, typically negative).

spread.description:
Basis spread (decimal, -0.0015 = -15 bp) added to the leg selected by
spread_on_base_leg. Exactly one of spread or quote_id must be present.
May be negative.

quote_id.description:
Reference to a shared quote in pricing.quotes (quote_type = Curve: the
basis moves with rates, so it takes part in the curve bump) instead of
an inline spread.

tenor.description: Swap tenor from the settlement (spot) date. Required.

fx_spot.description:
Id of the FxSpotSpec in pricing.fx.spots. Required. The spot names the
pair (base_index must be in its base_currency, quote_index in its
quote_currency) and supplies the settlement lag (spot_days, QuantLib
fixingDays). Its rate does not enter a constant-notional bootstrap; its
settlement calendars and convention are not used either: the swap
schedule follows this helper's own calendar / business_day_convention
/ end_of_month.

base_index.description:
Forwarding index of the base-currency leg (IndexDef id). Required; its
IndexDef.currency must equal the spot's base_currency. IBOR or
overnight (see payment_frequency).

base_forwarding_curve.description:
Forwarding curve of base_index, by id. Required; must name another
curve of pricing.rates.curves (bootstrapped first), never the curve
being bootstrapped: the leg's forwards are projected off this curve
while the curve under construction only discounts.

base_discount_curve.description:
Discount curve of the base-currency leg, by id. Exactly one of
base_discount_curve / quote_discount_curve is given: the given one is
the collateral currency's discount curve (bootstrapped first), the
absent one is the curve being bootstrapped.

quote_index.description:
Forwarding index of the quote-currency leg (IndexDef id). Required; its
IndexDef.currency must equal the spot's quote_currency. IBOR or
overnight (see payment_frequency).

quote_forwarding_curve.description:
Forwarding curve of quote_index, by id. Required; same rules as
base_forwarding_curve. It may be the same curve as the quote leg's
discount curve (a single USD OIS curve both projects and discounts).

quote_discount_curve.description:
Discount curve of the quote-currency leg, by id. See
base_discount_curve.

spread_on_base_leg.description:
true: the basis spread is added to the base-currency leg; false: to
the quote-currency leg. Required.

payment_frequency.description:
Coupon frequency of a compounded overnight leg. Required when
base_index or quote_index is an overnight index (QuantLib builds the
overnight leg as compounded coupons on this schedule); when the other
leg is an IBOR index the value must equal that index's tenor. Must be
absent when both indices are IBOR: each leg then pays at its index
tenor and there is nothing to choose.

payment_lag.description:
Payment lag in business days (helper calendar, Following) applied to
every coupon and to the final notional exchange of both legs. Required;
must be >= 0. The pillar date of the helper is the last payment date,
so a non-zero lag moves it.

calendar.description:
Calendar of the swap schedule (settlement date = valuation date +
spot_days on it, coupon dates, payment lag). Required.

business_day_convention.description: Business-day convention of the swap schedule. Required.

end_of_month.description: End-of-month rule of the swap schedule. Required.

mtm_reset.description:
Mark-to-market (resetting) notionals. Required; must be false in this
version: a resetting-notional swap (QuantLib
MtMCrossCurrencyBasisSwapRateHelper) is not supported yet and is
rejected with 400.

quantra_PointsWrapper.description: Wrapper for a single curve point.

bootstrap_trait.description:
Curve family selector. Present ⇒ selects how the curve is built from its
points (Discount/ZeroRate/FwdRate bootstrap from rate helpers;
InterpolatedZero interpolates explicit zero-rate points). Absent ⇒ the
request is rejected — there is no auto-dispatch by point type.

quantra_OptionQuote.description:
One listed-option quote line: a strike at an expiry with the call and put
sides as quoted (bid/ask), plus optional liquidity fields. Shared by the
implied-forward calibration (`/calibrate-implied-forwards`) and the
vol-surface calibration that consumes its forwards. Prices are in the
underlying's currency per unit of underlying (not per contract).

Every scalar is presence-required where it is needed: a strike or a price
that is absent is reported as a dropped quote with a reason, never read as
0.0. A line may carry only one side (call or put); it then cannot enter a
parity fit and is dropped with reason "missing call or put side".

strike.description: Strike in underlying price units. Must be > 0.

call_volume.description:
Traded volume on the quote date (contracts). Informational; echoed
nowhere, reserved for filters.

quantra_OptionQuoteSheet.description:
A sheet of listed-option quotes for one underlying on one date (the
request's `pricing.as_of_date`). The spot is NOT on the sheet: it is the
`spot_quote_id` of the referenced `EquityUnderlyingSpec` in
`pricing.equity.equity_underlyings`, so the same number prices the
options and seeds the forward fit.

underlying_id.description:
`EquityUnderlyingSpec.id` in `pricing.equity.equity_underlyings`.
Only its spot quote is read here; its `dividend_yield_curve_id` must
resolve (the shared registry requires it) but is not used by the
implied-forward fit — a flat 0 % placeholder curve is the convention.

option_style.description:
Exercise style of the listed options. Put-call parity, the identity
the forward fit rests on, holds for European exercise only: American
quotes (single stocks, some ETFs) carry an early-exercise premium that
biases the fit, so `/calibrate-implied-forwards` rejects any style
other than European with 400 naming this field. Index options (NDX,
RUT, SPX, SX5E) are European.

quantra_QuoteFilter.description:
Quote-quality filter applied before the parity fit. Every threshold is
echoed back on the response so the caller sees what was applied.

max_relative_spread.description:
Maximum (ask - bid) / mid on EACH side (call and put) of a line.
Must be > 0.

min_quotes_per_expiry.description:
Minimum number of call/put pairs an expiry needs AFTER both filter
passes to be fitted; an expiry with fewer is reported as dropped
(not a 400, unless no expiry survives). Must be >= 2.

moneyness_window.description:
Second-pass window: after a first fit over every surviving pair gives
a provisional forward F1, only strikes inside
[F1 * (1 - w), F1 * (1 + w)] enter the final fit. Must be > 0.

min_open_interest.description:
Optional: drop a line whose call OR put open interest is below this
(a line without open-interest fields is kept when the threshold is
absent and dropped when it is present).

quantra_DroppedQuote.description:
One quote line (or one whole expiry, when `strike` is absent) excluded
from the fit, with the rule that excluded it.

strike.description: Absent when the whole expiry was dropped.

quantra_ImpliedForwardExpiry.description:
Per-expiry fit report. Every expiry present on the sheet appears once,
in date order. Fit outputs (`forward` onwards) are present iff `usable`
is true; a dropped expiry carries `dropped_reason` and its `dropped`
lines instead.

time.description: Act/365F year fraction from `pricing.as_of_date` to the expiry.

quotes_used.description: Call/put pairs that entered the final fit.

quotes_dropped.description: Lines of this expiry excluded by a filter rule (count of `dropped`).

usable.description: True iff the expiry was fitted.

dropped_reason.description: Why the expiry was not fitted (absent when `usable`).

forward.description: Implied forward F: the strike at which C - P = 0 on the fitted line.

implied_discount_factor.description:
Implied discount factor DF = -slope of C - P against K: the market's
funding of the index to this expiry.

curve_discount_factor.description: Discount factor of the request's discounting curve at the expiry.

implied_funding_bp.description:
Continuous spread between the two discount factors, in basis points:
-ln(DF_implied / DF_curve) / T * 1e4. Positive = the options imply a
higher funding rate than the curve.

implied_dividend_yield.description:
Continuous dividend (equity repo + dividend) yield q(T) from
F = S * exp((r(T) - q(T)) * T), r(T) = -ln(DF_curve) / T.

fit_residual_rmse.description: Root-mean-square of the fit residuals C - P - (a + b K), price units.

quantra_ImpliedForwardPoint.description: Plain forward table: one row per fitted expiry, in date order.

spot.description: Spot read from the underlying's spot quote.

filter.description: The filter actually applied (request values or the defaults).

expiries.description: Per-expiry report, every sheet expiry, date order.

dividend_curve_spec.description:
Ready-to-paste `InterpolatedZero` curve (Act/365F, linear, continuous
zero points) with id `dividend_curve_id`: a point at the as-of date
carrying the first fitted expiry's yield (flat short end; the curve's
first node is its reference date) and one point per fitted expiry
with q(T). Discounting on the request curve and dividends on this
curve reproduces every fitted forward exactly.

quantra_StructuredNoteTermsUnderlying.description: One basket underlying as the engine booked it.

initial_level.description: Strike level the performances are measured against.

quanto.description: True when the underlying is quanto'd into the note currency.

fx_spot_id.description:
FX spot id of the quanto block; absent for a same-currency
underlying.

fx_volatility_id.description:
FX volatility id of the quanto block; absent for a same-currency
underlying.

fx_underlying_correlation.description:
Underlying/FX correlation of the quanto block; absent for a
same-currency underlying.

quantra_StructuredNoteTermsEvent.description: One observation event as the engine booked it (request order).

autocall_trigger.description: Absent = no call test at this event.

coupon_trigger.description: Absent = no coupon test of its own at this event.

coupon.description: Absent = no coupon of its own at this event.

accrual_only.description: True for an event with neither trigger (coupon accrues to memory).

final.description: True for the last event (capital test runs here).

is_final.description:
True when the request marked the event `is_final`: a maturity-only
observation where only the capital protection block (and `upside`)
is tested, with no coupon test and no call test. False for a final
event that carries a trigger.

resolved_from_history.description:
True when `observation_date` is on or before the valuation date:
the event was resolved from `historical_levels` (see
`StructuredNoteSeasoning`) and not simulated.

quantra_StructuredNoteTermsEcho.description:
The booked terms as the engine understood them: a mis-read factsheet is
visible here before the price is trusted. Always present. Defaults are
filled in (put_strike, participation, funding spread, Monte Carlo
settings).

correlation_id.description:
Absent for a single-underlying note (simulated on a 1 x 1 unit
matrix).

correlation_markup.description: The request's `correlation_markup`; absent when none was given.

correlation_markup_repaired.description:
True when the marked-up matrix was not positive semi-definite and
was repaired before pricing (see `StructuredNote.correlation_markup`).
False without a mark-up.

paths.description: Paths requested (the number actually simulated is on the result).

steps_per_year.description: Absent when the grid is the observation dates only.

quantra_StructuredNoteResolvedEvent.description: One past event evaluated on the supplied historical levels.

accrual_only.description:
True for an accrual-only event (no levels read; coupon added to the
memory).

levels.description:
Closing levels used, one per underlying in `terms.underlyings`
order; empty for an accrual-only event.

performances.description:
Level / initial level, one per underlying; empty for an accrual-only
event.

basket_performance.description:
Basket performance under `performance_rule`; absent for an
accrual-only event.

called.description: Call test outcome; absent when the event has no `autocall_trigger`.

coupon_earned.description:
Coupon test outcome (or, with only an `autocall_trigger`, the call
test); absent when the event carries no coupon test.

coupon_paid.description:
Coupon amount (fraction of notional) paid on this event's payment
date, memory included; 0 when nothing was paid.

memory_after.description: Coupon memory (fraction of notional) carried out of this event.

quantra_StructuredNoteSeasoning.description:
How the note's past was resolved before anything was simulated. Always
present (empty `events` for a note with no past event).

as_of_date.description: Valuation date the past/future split was made on.

status.description: Where the note stands after the past events.

memory_carried.description: Coupon memory (fraction of notional) entering the simulation.

next_event_index.description:
Index of the first simulated event; absent when none (Called or
Matured).

known_payment_date.description:
For a Called or Matured note: the known payment date and amount
(fraction of notional, redemption and coupons together). The NPV
is that amount discounted when the date is after the valuation
date, 0 otherwise. Absent for an Alive note.

quantra_StructuredNoteModelUnderlying.description: The model used for one underlying.

vol_shape.description:
Shape of the volatility used (Constant, AtmMatrix2D = term,
SmileCube3D / SurfaceFromPrices = local vol).

local_vol.description:
True when the paths were evolved under Dupire local volatility
derived from a surface.

quanto_drift.description:
Quanto drift adjustment -rho * sigma_S * sigma_FX applied
(annualised, in rate units, at the first observation); absent for a
same-currency underlying.

quantra_StructuredNoteModelEcho.description: The simulation set-up as used. Always present.

observation_dates_only.description: True when the time grid is the (future) observation dates only.

time_steps.description: Number of time steps of the grid.

time_grid.description:
The grid, in years from the valuation date (day counter of the
discounting curve).

sequence_dimension.description: Dimension of the random sequence (time steps x underlyings).

quantra_StructuredNoteBucket.description:
Present value of one cash-flow bucket, from the same paths as the
headline NPV, with its own standard error.

pv.description: PV in the note currency (capital_loss is <= 0).

quantra_StructuredNoteLegs.description:
NPV split by cash-flow bucket; the three sum to the headline `npv` to
rounding.

bond_redemption.description: Notional returned (on call or at maturity, before any loss).

capital_loss.description: Loss on the redemption when the barrier is breached (negative).

quantra_StructuredNoteEventProbability.description: Call and coupon probabilities of one simulated event.

p_call.description:
Probability that the note is alive at this event and the call test
holds; absent when the event has no `autocall_trigger`.

p_coupon.description:
Probability that the note is alive at this event and a coupon is
earned (paid or held); absent when the event carries no coupon test.

quantra_StructuredNoteUnderlyingGreeks.description:
Sensitivities of one underlying by bump-and-reprice on common random
numbers (every bumped run uses the same seed, paths, grid and random
sequence as the price), in the note currency, scaled to unit moves. Each
sensitivity carries the Monte Carlo standard error of the DIFFERENCE
(accumulated per path, not the difference of two standard errors), which
is what the common random numbers make small.

delta.description:
NPV change per +1% move of the spot: central difference of the spot
bumped by +/- `spot_bump` (relative), (V+ - V-) / (2 spot_bump) x
0.01. Only the spot quote moves: the initial level (strike fixing),
the dividend curve and the volatility (sticky strike for a surface)
stay.

gamma.description:
Change of `delta` per +1% move of the spot: (V+ - 2 V0 + V-) /
spot_bump^2 x 0.01^2.

vega.description:
NPV change per +1 vol point: the underlying's Black volatility
shifted by +`vol_bump` (absolute; a constant vol, every node of a
term vol, every entry of a strike x expiry surface, from which the
local vol is re-derived), (V(sigma + vol_bump) - V0) / vol_bump x
0.01. For a quanto underlying the shifted vol also enters the quanto
drift (-rho x sigma_S x sigma_FX).

quantra_StructuredNoteGreeks.description:
Opt-in Greeks (absent unless `greeks` was in the request). Cost: 1 + 2N
+ N + 3 full simulations for N underlyings (2 for a single underlying,
which has no correlation sensitivity), all on the same random stream.

correlation_sensitivity.description:
NPV change per +0.01 on every off-diagonal correlation: every
off-diagonal entry shifted by +`correlation_bump`, clipped to
[-1, 1], (V(rho + bump) - V0) / correlation_bump x 0.01. Absent for a
single underlying.

correlation_bump_repaired.description:
True when the bumped correlation matrix was not positive
semi-definite and was repaired before repricing: eigenvalue
clipping (negative eigenvalues set to 0, V diag(max(lambda, 0)) V^T)
followed by a rescaling to unit diagonal. False for a single
underlying.

correlation_bumped.description:
The correlation matrix the bumped run used (after clipping and, when
`correlation_bump_repaired`, the repair), row-major n x n in the
note's underlying order. Absent for a single underlying.

funding_dv01.description:
NPV change per +1bp of funding spread: the spread shifted by
+`funding_bump_bp` on the discounting only (the processes drift on
the plain curve), (V(s + bump) - V0) / funding_bump_bp.

rho.description:
NPV change per +1bp parallel move of `discounting_curve`: a
continuously compounded zero spread of +`rate_bump_bp` on the note
curve, applied both to the processes' risk-free rate (the drift of a
note-currency underlying; a quanto underlying's drift is r_local - q
- rho sigma_S sigma_FX and does not move, its quanto curve is
rebuilt on the shifted note curve) and to the discounting of every
cash flow, the funding spread staying on top; (V(r + bump) - V0) /
rate_bump_bp.

spot_bump.description: Bump sizes used, as requested or defaulted.

quantra_StructuredNoteMarketUnderlying.description:
Market as used for one underlying, one entry per simulated observation
date (the `observation_dates` of the parent block). Deterministic: read
from the curves and vols the processes were built on, no simulation.

forwards.description:
Forward level at each observation date: spot x D_div(t) / D_note(t)
with D_div the process's dividend curve (the QuantoTermStructure for
a quanto underlying, so the quanto drift is included) and D_note the
note's discounting curve without the funding spread, both at the
Actual/365 (Fixed) time t of the simulation grid. This is the level
the deterministic forward walk of `checks` uses.

implied_dividend_yields.description:
Continuously-compounded dividend yield of the underlying's own
dividend curve (quanto adjustment excluded) implied between
consecutive observation dates, the first from the valuation date:
-ln(D(t_j) / D(t_{j-1})) / (t_j - t_{j-1}).

implied_rates.description:
Continuously-compounded rate of the underlying's own currency (the
quanto block's `discounting_curve`, or the note curve for a
same-currency underlying) implied between consecutive observation
dates, as above.

atm_vols.description:
Black volatility used to each observation date at the forward of
that date (ATM).

barrier_vols.description:
Black volatility used to each observation date at the capital
barrier strike, `capital.barrier x initial_level`. Equals
`atm_vols` for a constant or term vol (`model.underlyings[].local_vol`
false): the strike is only read on a strike x expiry surface.

quanto_drift_bp.description:
Quanto drift adjustment applied, -rho x sigma_S x sigma_FX in basis
points per year, with sigma_S the underlying's Black vol at
`initial_level` and sigma_FX the FX vol at the FX spot, both to the
final simulated observation date; rho is the quanto block's
`fx_underlying_correlation` as given (correlation with the FX rate
quoted as note-currency units per one unit of the underlying's
currency), so a positive rho gives a negative adjustment. Absent for
a same-currency underlying.

payment_dates.description:
Every future payment date, in order: the payment date of each
simulated event followed by `maturity_payment_date` when it is not
already the last one.

discount_factors.description: Discount factor on `discounting_curve` at each payment date.

discount_factors_with_funding.description: Discount factor with the funding spread at each payment date.

correlation_labels.description: Labels of the correlation matrix as used (underlying order).

correlation.description:
The correlation matrix as used, row-major n x n, permuted to the
note's underlying order; the 1 x 1 unit matrix for a single
underlying. The supplied matrix is never repaired (one that is not
positive semi-definite is a 400); with a `correlation_markup` this is
the shifted (and, when needed, repaired) matrix the simulation ran on.

correlation_base.description:
With a `correlation_markup`: the matrix as supplied, before the
shift, same order. Absent otherwise.

correlation_markup.description: The request's `correlation_markup`; absent when none was given.

quantra_StructuredNoteEventDecomposition.description:
`diagnostics.decomposition`: one simulated event (accrual-only events
are not listed: nothing is observed or paid on them).

p_call.description:
Absent when the event has no `autocall_trigger` (same value as
`event_probabilities`).

p_coupon.description:
Absent when the event carries no coupon test (same value as
`event_probabilities`).

pv_coupons.description:
PV, in the note currency, of the coupons paid on this event's
payment date (memory included), averaged over the paths.

pv_redemption.description:
PV, in the note currency, of the notional returned on this event's
payment date (a call), or, on the final event, of the redemption
before any loss (upside included) on `maturity_payment_date`.

quantra_StructuredNoteDecompositionDiagn.description:
`diagnostics.decomposition`. The event PVs add up to the buckets:
sum(pv_coupons) = legs.coupons.pv and sum(pv_redemption) =
legs.bond_redemption.pv, less any flow the past already fixed (listed
in `seasoning`, not here); the capital loss is on `legs.capital_loss`
with its standard error, as are the bucket standard errors.

p_survive_to_maturity.description: Probability that the note is not called before the final event.

p_breach.description: Probability that the capital barrier is breached.

expected_life_years.description: Expected time to the note's end, in years from the valuation date.

expected_loss_given_breach.description:
Expected loss conditional on a breach, as a positive fraction of the
notional, undiscounted: E[loss x 1{breach}] / p_breach with loss =
participation x max(put_strike - perf_final, 0). Absent when no path
breached (p_breach = 0).

quantra_StructuredNoteRunningMean.description:
Running estimate of the NPV after a fraction of the samples, in
simulation order (an antithetic pair is one sample).

fraction.description:
Fraction of the samples used (0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0; a fraction is
omitted when its sample count would be 0 or repeat the previous
one).

paths.description: Simulated paths used (samples, or 2 x samples with antithetic).

npv.description: NPV estimate over those paths, in the note currency.

standard_error.description: Its standard error (the same estimator as the headline's).

deterministic_forward_npv.description:
Price of the payoff walked once along the forward path: every
underlying at its `market` forward on every grid date (zero
volatility), the same state machine as the simulation, no random
numbers.

correlation_one_npv.description:
Price with every off-diagonal correlation forced to 1 (one extra run
on the same random stream, paths, seed and grid). With a single
underlying it is the headline price (no extra run).

correlation_zero_npv.description:
Price with every off-diagonal correlation forced to 0 (the identity
matrix; one extra run on the same stream). With a single underlying
it is the headline price (no extra run).

bond_only_npv.description:
notional x discount factor (funding spread included) at
`maturity_payment_date`: the value of the note if it were a
zero-coupon bond of the issuer.

quantra_StructuredNoteQuantiles.description:
Quantiles of the basket performance (`performance_rule` applied) at one
simulated observation date, over every simulated path: each path of an
antithetic pair counts on its own (the pairs are averaged for the price
statistics only). Quantile definition: linear interpolation between
order statistics, q(p) = x[h] + (h - floor(h)) x (x[floor(h) + 1] -
x[floor(h)]) with h = (n - 1) x p on the ascending values x[0..n-1]
(the default of R and NumPy). The basket performance is recorded at the
observation date whether or not the note is still alive on that path.

quantra_StructuredNoteHistogramBin.description:
One bin of the payout histogram: 20 bins of equal width between the
smallest and the largest payout over the paths, edges lower_k = min +
k x (max - min) / 20. When every path pays the same amount all 20 bins
have zero width and every path is in the first one.

upper.description: Upper edge, exclusive (inclusive for the last bin).

paths.description: Simulated paths in the bin; the bins sum to the result's `paths`.

quantra_StructuredNoteSamplePath.description: One simulated path, summarised (raw levels are never returned).

basket_performances.description:
Basket performance at each simulated observation date (the
`observation_date`s of `basket_performance_quantiles`), recorded
whether or not the note is still alive on that date.

payout.description:
Undiscounted total payout of the path, fraction of notional:
every coupon and redemption paid after the valuation date on this
path, loss and upside included, plus any flow the past already
fixed (identical on every path).

payout_pv.description:
The same payout discounted on the funding curve, fraction of
notional; its average over the paths is npv / notional.

called_on.description:
Observation date of the call; absent when the path reached the
final event.

breached.description: True when the capital barrier was breached.

quantra_StructuredNoteDistributionDiagno.description:
`diagnostics.distribution`. Every statistic is over the individual
simulated paths (`paths` of the result).

payout_q05.description:
Quantiles of the undiscounted total payout per path (fraction of
notional, as `StructuredNoteSamplePath.payout`), same quantile
definition as `StructuredNoteQuantiles`.

sample_paths.description:
The first `sample_paths` paths in simulation order (with antithetic:
path, its antithetic, next path, ...); empty when 0.

stage.description:
`market_build` (curves, quanto curves, grid, processes),
`simulation` (path generation and payoff walk together: the path
engine hands each path to the walk as it is generated, so the two
are not separable), `deterministic_forward`, `correlation_one`,
`correlation_zero` (the extra runs of `checks`, present only when
run), `diagnostics` (sorting and summarising the per-path records),
and with `greeks` one stage per bumped run: `greek_spot_up_<id>`,
`greek_spot_down_<id>`, `greek_vol_<id>` per underlying,
`greek_correlation` (two or more underlyings), `greek_funding`,
`greek_rate`.

total_milliseconds.description:
Wall-clock time of the whole note, from the first market lookup to
the last diagnostic (the stages' sum plus the untimed remainder).

quantra_StructuredNoteRepricedOption.description:
One listed quote repriced on the simulated paths
(`diagnostics.vanilla_repricing`).

expiry.description: Expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD), a point of the repricing time grid.

time.description: Actual/365 (Fixed) years from the valuation date.

option_type.description:
The side priced: the out-of-the-money one with respect to the model
forward (`Call` when strike >= forward, `Put` otherwise), as
`/calibrate-vol-surface` selects it.

model_price.description:
`discount_factor x mean of max(+/-(S_T - K), 0)` over the simulated
paths, `S_T` the simulated level at the expiry grid point and
`discount_factor` the note's discounting curve without the funding
spread (listed options are not note liabilities).

standard_error.description:
Monte Carlo standard error of `model_price` (the path engine's
estimator, discounted).

market_vol.description:
Black-76 implied vol of the mid on the model forward and discount
factor of the expiry; absent when the mid does not solve (outside
the Black bounds).

model_vol.description:
Black-76 implied vol of `model_price` on the same forward and
discount factor; absent when it does not solve.

vol_error.description: model_vol - market_vol; absent when either is.

quantra_StructuredNoteRepricingExpiry.description: One sheet expiry as the repricing used it.

forward.description:
The model forward of the underlying at the expiry: spot x
D_div(T) / D_note(T) on the simulation's time axis (the forward the
process drifts along, quanto excluded).

discount_factor.description: D_note(T), the discounting curve without the funding spread.

dropped.description:
Every line not used, with its reason (the per-line quality rules of
`/calibrate-implied-forwards`, then the out-of-the-money side's mid
below 1e-5 of the spot or without an implied vol).

quantra_StructuredNoteVanillaRepricingUn.description: The repricing of one sheet (one underlying).

expiries.description:
Every sheet expiry in date order (an expiry on or before the
valuation date is reported with every line dropped).

max_abs_price_error.description: Largest |model_price - mid| over the used quotes (price units).

max_abs_vol_error.description:
Largest |model_vol - market_vol| (vol units) over the used quotes
where both solve; absent when none does.

max_standard_error.description: Largest standard error over the used quotes, in price units.

quantra_StructuredNoteVanillaRepricing.description:
`diagnostics.vanilla_repricing`: every usable quote of the request's
sheets priced as a European option on ONE extra simulation of the
note's model (same market, correlation, sequence, seed and paths; the
time grid is the note's grid with the sheet expiries added as mandatory
dates), so that the quotes a surface was calibrated to are repriced
through the very paths the note is priced on. The headline and every
other block are computed on the note's own grid and are unchanged by
this flag; `note_npv` is the note walked on the repricing grid so the
effect of the extra grid points is visible (Monte Carlo noise: with
`steps_per_year` the grid refinement differs where an expiry splits an
interval, and without it the exact lognormal steps simply pass through
more dates; both change the random stream, neither changes the model).

time_steps.description: Steps of the repricing grid (the note's grid plus the expiries).

note_npv.description: The note's NPV and standard error on the repricing paths.

quantra_StructuredNoteResult.description:
Pricing result of one structured note. The headline is `npv` with its
standard error, the path count and the seed; the terms echo, the
seasoning resolution and the model echo are always present so the
booked terms can be checked before the price is trusted; Greeks and
the diagnostic blocks are present only when requested. For a note whose
past already decided it (`seasoning.status` Called or Matured) nothing
is simulated: `paths` is 0 and every simulation statistic is absent.

npv.description: Present value in the note currency.

standard_error.description:
Monte Carlo standard error of `npv`; absent when nothing was
simulated.

paths.description: Paths actually simulated (0 when nothing was).

legs.description: NPV by cash-flow bucket; absent when nothing was simulated.

event_probabilities.description:
One entry per simulated event, in order; empty when nothing was
simulated.

p_barrier_breach.description:
Probability that the capital barrier is breached; absent when
nothing was simulated.

expected_life_years.description:
Expected time to the note's end in years from the valuation date;
absent when nothing was simulated.

greeks.description:
Absent unless `greeks` was requested (a `greeks` block on a note
whose past already decided it is a 400: there is nothing to bump).

market.description: Absent unless requested in `diagnostics` (or nothing was simulated).

vanilla_repricing.description:
Absent unless `diagnostics.vanilla_repricing` was set (or nothing
was simulated).

quantra_PriceStructuredNoteResponse.description: Response wrapper for multiple structured notes, in request order.
